scenarios.title: 1. Overlooked exception (hero)
scenarios.question: My customer wants to place SGD 20,000 into a SteadyGrowth 12-month fixed deposit by FAST transfer today. What interest rate should I quote?
scenarios.ai_answer: The SteadyGrowth 12-month fixed deposit earns the 3.20% p.a. board rate. Your customer's SGD 20,000 deposit meets the SGD 10,000 minimum, and the board rate applies to deposits funded via FAST transfer, so you can confidently quote 3.20% p.a. [Sources: FD-101, FD-500]

scenarios.title: 2. Conflicting documents
scenarios.question: My customer wants to take out their SteadyGrowth fixed deposit before it matures. Is there a penalty?
scenarios.ai_answer: Yes. Early withdrawal of a SteadyGrowth fixed deposit before maturity incurs a penalty of 1.0% of the principal, so tell the customer they will lose 1.0% of their principal. [Source: FD-200]

scenarios.title: 3. Outdated or inapplicable policy
scenarios.question: What is the maximum FAST transfer amount per transaction for a retail customer?
scenarios.ai_answer: FAST transfers for retail customers are limited to SGD 200,000 per transaction, and the limit is applied to each single transaction. [Source: FD-300]

scenarios.title: 4. Unsupported assumption
scenarios.question: What interest rate will my customer get on a SteadyGrowth 12-month fixed deposit?
scenarios.ai_answer: The customer will earn the 3.20% p.a. board rate on a SteadyGrowth 12-month fixed deposit, and the 12-month tenor is available. [Sources: FD-101, FD-400]

scenarios.title: 5. Clean control
scenarios.question: What is the minimum placement for a SteadyGrowth fixed deposit, and which tenors can the customer pick?
scenarios.ai_answer: The minimum placement for a SteadyGrowth fixed deposit is SGD 1,000, and the customer can choose a tenor of 6, 12 or 24 months. [Source: FD-400]
